title: PigForge Part Content v1
description: Engine-agnostic part and collision content. Files authored against this schema contain no engine asset references (no Unity Asset GUIDs, no GameObject or scene paths); engines bind their own assets to parts via partTypeId.

damping.description: Unity's per-rigidbody `Rigidbody.drag` / `angularDrag` (renamed `linearDamping` / `angularDamping` in Unity 6), extracted by tools/bple-damping and never authored. Both values are required and neither may be negative, because a negative damping would accelerate a body instead of slowing it. The original applies them as PhysX does -- `v *= max(0, 1 - damping * dt)` after gravity and before the solver (`DyBodyCoreIntegrator.h::bodyCoreComputeUnconstrainedVelocity`) -- which the original's own editor confirmed to the last bit (unity/PigForge.WeldProbe body-defaults probe: 0.996 per 0.02 s step for 0.2 drag, max abs error 0 over 51 samples).

linear.description: `Rigidbody.drag` -- 0.2 on every part (BasePart.cs:1200), 1 on a wing/tail, 2 on a balloon, 1 on a sandbag, 0.5 on the king pig.

angular.description: `Rigidbody.angularDrag` -- 0.05 on every part (BasePart.cs:1201), 0.2 on a wing/tail, 0.5 on a balloon, 10 on a sandbag, 1 on the king pig.

physics.description: The original's project-wide rigidbody defaults every part inherits, declared once instead of per part (tools/bple-damping). A dynamic part overrides `damping` only where its original class overrides `BasePart.EnsureRigidbody` (wing, tail, balloon, sandbag, king pig); a static part must not declare one at all.

maximumAngularSpeed.description: Unity's `Physics.defaultMaxAngularSpeed` in radians per second, which every original rigidbody inherits as `Rigidbody.maxAngularVelocity`: the original's `ProjectSettings/DynamicsManager.asset` declares `m_DefaultMaxAngularSpeed: 7`, no script assigns `maxAngularVelocity` and none of the 343 `Part_*.prefab` serialize `m_MaxAngularVelocity`. PhysX clamps the magnitude after damping (`if (angVelSq > maxAngularVelocitySq) angularVelocity *= sqrt(maxSq / angVelSq)`); the same editor probe measured a body seeded at 100 rad/s reading exactly 7 after one step, and 100 with the cap raised to 1000.

frictionCombine.description: Unity's PhysicMaterialCombine, extracted per collider by tools/bple-materials. A pair uses the higher-priority mode (Average < Minimum < Multiply < Maximum); the wheel tyres are Multiply, which is why a tyre slides instead of gripping like its hub.

variantOf.description: Base partTypeId this entry is a skin/variant of. Must reference a declared non-variant part.

variantName.description: Display label for the variant; the renderer falls back to name.

gridBox.description: The original's build-grid cell box (BasePart.cs:197-200: m_gridXmin/m_gridXmax/m_gridYmin/m_gridYmax), the inclusive rectangle of cells a part occupies around its own grid coordinate -- ConstructionUI.cs:1279,1344 tests membership as `x + minX <= cellX && x + maxX >= cellX` and iterates the same inclusive range. Extracted per prefab by tools/bple-grid, never authored. Absent means the original's default: one cell at the origin (0..0, 0..0), which is 332 of the original's 343 prefabs -- every propeller, fan, wing, spotlight, grapple, spring and pig; only the KingPig/GoldenPig families declare the 3x2 box x[-1, 1] y[0, 1]. Occupancy (server `CellsOccupied`, cell clearing) uses this box; a collider that overhangs a neighbouring cell does not occupy it.

minX.description: Leftmost occupied cell index, relative to the part's own cell (0).

maxX.description: Rightmost occupied cell index, inclusive; never below minX.

minY.description: Bottommost occupied cell index, relative to the part's own cell (0).

maxY.description: Topmost occupied cell index, inclusive; never below minY.

connectionVisual.description: The script the original prefab mounts to decide which conditional colliders are solid for the current connection state (Rocket.cs:139-165 sets `isTrigger = !activeInHierarchy`, so only the shown marker is solid; TNT.cs:86-108 / SpotLight.cs:70-105 / GrapplingHook.cs:218-255 do the same with SetActive; Wings.cs:41-75 also swaps the root collider between a thin top-only and a thick bottom form). `attachmentFallback` = Rocket.cs (each marker follows its side, and `bottom` is also the ghost shown when no other side can connect); `attachmentPlain` = TNT.cs (each marker follows its side, no fallback); `attachmentEight` = SpotLight.cs/GrapplingHook.cs (the diagonals show only on a 45-degree turn); `frame` = Wings.cs/JetEngine.cs. Copied from the sprite manifest's already-derived rule by tools/bple-connections; the client renderer keeps its own copy in that manifest (ADR-014). Absent means the part has no conditional colliders to gate.

spring.description: The original Spring's own joint (Spring.cs:100-134): a breakable bungee rope (SpringJoint) or a y soft limit (ConfigurableJoint) holding the two neighbours at their assembly distance. It never applies an impulse -- the old bounce-pad reading is gone. Extracted per skin by tools/bple-springs, never authored.

glove.description: The interactive SpringBoxingGlove (spec docs/specs/boxing-glove.md): a second rigid body 'glove' held to the host by a y-limited, y/x-driven joint, shot out on trigger and wound back. Extracted by tools/bple-springs from the part prefab and its BoxingGlove*.prefab reference, never authored.

mirror.description: Original BasePart.m_autoAlign == FlipVertically (2): this part's build pose has a handedness (a 180-degree turn about the part's own up axis, applied inside its own frame before the yaw), which a float yaw cannot express. Extracted by tools/bple-aero from the prefab, never authored.

jointConnectionType.description: Original BasePart.m_jointConnectionType: whether this part offers (source), accepts (target), or refuses (none) a weld. Two adjacent parts merge only when neither is none and at least one is source.

jointConnectionStrength.description: Original BasePart.m_jointConnectionStrength: the per-part weld strength enum. The floats live in the original GameData asset (GameData.asset:101-105) and are resolved in code; extracted by tools/bple-joints, never authored. Absent on the three parts with no prefab, which fall back to normal.

jointConnectionDirection.description: Original BasePart.m_jointConnectionDirection: the part-local sides this part may weld on (the client's build-time alignment only snaps on those sides). Extracted by tools/bple-joints, never authored.

canEnclose.description: True only for frames (WoodenFrame/MetalFrame prefabs). CanBeEnclosed is derived as !canEnclose in code, never authored.

attachment.description: Runtime attachment (balloon string, sandbag tie): searched for an anchor part at start of simulation and tied to it with a rope joint (minDistance 0).

suspension.description: Elastic wheel attachment: the original's own joint for a wheel that overrides CustomConnectToPart declares its local Y as a Limited axis held at restOffset by a linear-limit spring (OffRoadWheel.cs:202-220). Extracted by tools/bple-springs, never authored; parts without it keep the rigid axle weld.

powerConsumption.description: Original BasePart.m_powerConsumption (BasePart.cs:162): > 0 makes the part a consumer. While its switch is on it adds this to its cluster's consumption, the denominator of the power factor (Contraption.cs:540-556, :2633-2644). Extracted by tools/bple-power, never authored.

enginePower.description: Original BasePart.m_enginePower (BasePart.cs:164): > 0 makes the part an engine (BasePart.cs:606-608). While enclosed (Engine.cs:61) it adds this to its cluster's engine power, the numerator of the power factor; it never applies force itself (Engine.cs:29,138). Extracted by tools/bple-power, never authored.

direction.description: Which way the build searches for its anchor: up = hangs from the part above it (sandbag), down = floats above the part below it (balloon).

offset.description: Where the rope's anchor sits in the anchor part's local frame; the attached part rests at most maxDistance away from that point.

distanceFactor.description: Scaled rope limit: maxDistance = distanceFactor * (build separation + distanceOffset) + pigDistanceBonus when the anchor is a pig. Mutually exclusive with maxDistance.

stiffness.description: Unity linear-limit spring of the wheel's own joint, in N/m (m_springStiffness; OffRoadWheel.cs:49 default 150, Part_MotorWheel_08_SET serializes 50).

damper.description: Unity linear-limit spring damper, in N*s/m (OffRoadWheel.cs:214, a constant 5).

restOffset.description: The limited axis' rest offset along the wheel's own Y (linearLimit.limit, 0 = hold the build separation).

liftConstant.description: Original Wings.m_liftConstant (Wings.cs:6,114): lift = liftConstant * |v|^2 * curve(angle of attack), clamped to 100 N. Extracted by tools/bple-aero from the prefab, never authored.

bellowsCapability.description: The original's Bellows: a puff is a 0.5 s ramp `(1 - (1 - num/0.5)^2) * m_boostForce` along `transform.TransformDirection(m_direction)` at `transform.position + dir * 0.5`, followed by 0.3 s of nothing and an inflate animation; a fresh puff is refused until the cycle ends (Bellows.cs:92-121,123-142). The 0.5 s and 0.3 s are class constants and travel in no skin; only the force and the alien skin's shorter inflate do. Written by tools/bple-bellows.

thrustPerTick.description: m_boostForce / 60 (ADR-013 decision 4: ForceMode.Force at 60 Hz), 30 -> 0.5 and the alien skin 120 -> 2.0.

inflateTicks.description: 0.3 s of inflate for every skin, 0.15 s for the alien one (Bellows.cs:18-20,36-46), at 60 Hz.

tailCapability.description: Original Tail.m_liftConstant (Tail.cs:6,71), used by the same clamped |v|^2 curve the wing uses. Extracted by tools/bple-aero from the prefab, never authored.

joint.description: 'bungee' = the original takes the SpringJoint rope branch (StableSpringConnection and customPartIndex 0 or 2, Spring.cs:104); 'limit' = the y linear-limit ConfigurableJoint branch (Spring.cs:120). Extracted per skin by tools/bple-springs, never authored.

limit.description: SPRING_LIMIT, 0.1 m; the 'limit' path's linear limit (Spring.cs:11).

breakForce.description: The published breaking force: SPRING_BREAK_FORCE 250 doubled to 1200 by IN StrongSpringConnection (Spring.cs:15,38).

mass.description: The published rigidbody mass: IN StableSpringConnection forces 1 (Spring.cs:69-75).
The glove prefab's rigidbody mass (0.5, BoxingGlove*.prefab).

shapes.description: The glove prefab's colliders (a SphereCollider r 0.3).

limit.description: The host-glove joint's y linear limit (1).

solverIterationScale.description: The glove rigidbody's solver iteration factor (1.6, SpringBoxingGlove.cs:262).

distanceY.description: m_targetDistanceY; the glove's target is distanceY * IN BoxingGloveLength along the part's local -Y (the probe shows the glove travels down it).

deviationX.description: m_targetDeviationX, the lateral offset of the thrown glove.

time.description: m_ShootTime: how long the throw lasts before the wind-back (SpringBoxingGlove.cs:280-330).

limitSpring.description: The linear-limit spring the throw sets (0.1, SpringBoxingGlove.cs:333).

time.description: m_WindingTime: the wind-back deadline; the original also ends early once the glove is within 0.1 of home.

mass.description: The glove's mass while winding back (0.01, SpringBoxingGlove.cs:395).

ignitionTicks.description: The original's burn is three phases in seconds (Rocket.cs:228-300): m_ignitionTime, m_boostDuration, m_boostEndDuration. m_ignitionTime is a no-thrust phase for the bottle family only (its m_visualization suppresses the force, :236-240); m_boostDuration is full thrust and m_boostEndDuration the linear ramp back to zero (:266-269). All three travel as 60 Hz ticks, written by tools/bple-rockets.

maxSpeed.description: m_maximumSpeed: past this speed along the thrust axis the force is divided by (1 + v - maxSpeed) (Rocket.cs:529-541). The vanilla declaration defaults multiply it by RocketSpeed / CokeSodaSpeed, and the legendary bottles take AlienCokeSpeedValue / AlienSodaSpeedValue outright (Rocket.cs:180-200).

visualization.description: True only on the bottle family, whose prefab carries a `m_visualization`: while the burn is inside m_ignitionTime the original returns before applying any force (Rocket.cs:236-240). A plain rocket has none and thrusts from its first tick.

maxSpeed.description: Top speed along the thrust axis per unit engine power factor: the original's m_defaultSpeed x IN <X>Speed (FanPropeller.cs:90,100-106). Absent = the original never caps it (the plane propeller, whose PropellerSpeed is Infinity). See docs/specs/fan-propeller.md.

rotor.description: The original's m_isRotor: a rotor brakes quadratically once it moves past maxSpeed (FanPropeller.cs:198-207). Defaults to false.

chainDetonate.description: When it explodes, ignites other charges inside the blast radius. Defaults to true (original TNT chains).

igniteOnImpact.description: False = only the part switch can light it (original AlienTNT ignores collisions). Defaults to true.

chainRadius.description: Blasters inside this radius fire in the same tick (original BlasterTNT chain).

condition.description: Connection-gated geometry. An `attachment` marker is the collider the original shows on one part-local side (Rocket.cs:157-160 turns a hidden marker into a trigger): the spawn-time body includes the markers the connection state shows and excludes the rest, under the part's `connectionVisual` rule. A `frame` is the mounting bracket a part is aligned and welded by (ADR-018): the editor snaps it by the bracket and the server's connection proximity includes it, and a wing's `frame` additionally selects its two-state root collider (Wings.cs:62-71). Occupancy never uses either -- that is the part's declared `gridBox` (tools/bple-grid).
